claim_assertions.claim_1: Higher FY2025 earned membership fees contribute positively to the operating-income increase.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The supplied Q4 periods each contain one quarter of the full-year number of weeks.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Earned membership fees for the first 36 weeks of FY2025 were USD 3,599 million.

definitions.income_model: Output 16, 36 and 52 weeks for both years. Merchandise margin excludes earned membership fees from its numerator and uses net sales as denominator. For each year, derive every 36-week flow input as the 52-week amount less the 16-week amount before reconstructing 36-week gross profit, operating income and residual. Calculate 36-week merchandise_gross_margin_pct from 36-week merchandise gross profit divided by 36-week net sales, rather than subtracting margin percentages. The output operating_income_usd_million is reconstructed operating income: merchandise gross profit plus earned membership fees less SG&A expense. residual_usd_million is reconstructed operating income less independently reported operating income. The reported amount is the comparator and must not replace the reconstructed output.
definitions.operating_growth_bridge: Changes are FY2025 less FY2024 for each matched duration. SG&A is a signed negative contribution. The denominator is the change in independently reported operating income for that duration, even when reconstructed component totals disagree.
definitions.membership_accrual_bridge: The mechanical bridge is FY2025 earned fees plus closing less opening deferred fees. It is not labeled observed collections.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
